notes: Step 1 parts were correct; no parts added or dropped.
Pot legs are in columns 10, 11, 12 of the image's lower half. The catalogue names that half bank 't' (rows a-e), so they are 10t.e, 11t.e and 12t.e.

Pot ports: GND at column 10 (black wire), SIG (centre, wiper) at column 11 (yellow wire to A0), VCC at column 12 (red wire to 5V). This matches the text and schematic: one outer pin to 5V, centre to A0, other outer pin to ground. The pot's outer legs are symmetric, so swapping 5V and GND only reverses the reading direction.

In the image the yellow wire's breadboard end appears in the upper half of column 11, which would not touch the pot's centre leg in the lower half. I took this as a drawing quirk. The schematic requires the wiper on A0, so I put the yellow wire in the same strip as the centre leg (11t.d).
Black wire goes to the Uno GND pin next to 5V (GND.1). Either GND pin is equivalent.
